keys: Office automation library supporting read/write, template filling and format conversion for Excel (xlsx/xls), Word (docx/doc), PowerPoint (pptx/ppt), PDF, Markdown, RTF, ODS, Email (eml/msg), iCalendar, vCard, EPUB and XPS, with zero external dependencies and an MIT license.
